messages:
Sam K: deploy-bot put the staging promo on HOLD — manifest signature check failed on the canary image.

deploy-bot: PROMO_HOLD staging canary v2026.9.02 -> v2026.9.03
checks: manifest-signature: FAILED (signature verification mismatch for digest sha256:9f8a)
artifact-publish: SUCCEEDED (but signature attestation missing from registry)
logs: https://ci.internal/4412701234/artifacts/7

Riley: signature mismatch is odd. build pipeline reports successful cosign sign step. signing-bot, any failures on attestation push?

signing-bot: SIGNING_LOG: cosign upload reported OK at 03:08 UTC. Registry denied attestation attach (403) for subject sha256:9f8a during post. Policy enforced: require signed attestation for promote.

Sam K: so image uploaded but registry didn't attach attestation. Could be auth token scope on the signer role or a transient registry permission issue. infra-bot, any recent permission rotations or policy changes?

infra-bot: INFRA_CHANGE: service-account key rotation occurred at 02:55 UTC for registry-signer-role. IAM audit: attestation attach requests from signer returned 403 from 03:06-03:09 UTC, then succeeded at 03:11 UTC for unrelated artifact. No infra-wide outage recorded.

Riley: change window ends in 25m. Product wants this cut. Options: 1) pin to previous signed image v2026.9.02 and manual promote; 2) retry sign/attach and rerun verification (might meet window if fast); 3) delay cut. Thoughts?

Sam K: if attestation attach eventually succeeds we can re-run verify and promote in time. But given IAM rotation earlier, there's a risk other attachements will be delayed. Pinning is safest for the window. We should also rotate the signer creds and add a verification step in CI after push that checks registry attestation presence before promoting.

Riley: I agree. pin keeps SLA and avoids shipping unsigned-attestation edge case. We'll open a hotfix to add post-push attestation check and a follow-up to root cause the 403 on attach.

Sam K: plan: Riley to open promo-pin PR and manual promote playbook; infra to investigate IAM key rotation impact and revert if needed; signing-bot to re-run attestation attach for v2026.9.03 once creds validated. Add release note stating we pinned due to transient attestation attach failure.

Riley: creating PR https://git.internal/repo/promo-pin/314. Draft release note: "Pinned canary to v2026.9.02 because registry attestation attach for v2026.9.03 failed during IAM key rotation. Feature set will be revalidated and rolled forward after attestation confirmation. Contact @Riley."

infra-bot: TICKET_CREATED: infra ticket #1987 opened to investigate signer role key rotation and attestation 403s.

deploy-bot: ACTION: promo pinned to v2026.9.02 (manual override) by Riley at 4412701305. Release window preserved.

Sam K: thanks — follow-ups: Riley manual promote, signing-bot retry attach after infra fixes, CI to add post-push attestation verification. Closing hold.
